name: Identifiable Victim Effect
axiom: A statistic moves policy; one person moves an audience.
trigger: Funding cases for accessibility, safety or user experience, where the aggregate number has stopped persuading.

steps.text: State the aggregate, with its source.
Introduce one person inside it, briefly and factually.
Return to the aggregate: this person is one of the number.
Ask for the change that would have helped them.

antiPattern.violation: Using a story as a substitute for the number, so the audience commits to a case rather than to a policy.
antiPattern.remediation: Pair the person with the proportion. The story is the door; the number is what the door opens onto.

origin.title: The Life You Save May Be Your Own
